name: Luna's Adventures
source:
[url=/c122247]Luna[/url] doesn't have many friends. She's the weird kid. The freak. The quiet girl at the back of the class that sometimes stares at you too long. No one really likes her...

Horny and equipped with a new toy to try out, little Luna decides to entertain herself. But her risky self-pleasure at school is bound to be discovered eventually!

Only Luna can have the sort of shitty luck to be caught masturbating and talking to herself by her most feared bully, and then left to fend for herself naked!

Just how will she get out of this exposed situation?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
[url=/c122247]露娜[/url]没有什么朋友。她是大家眼里的怪胎、异类，是坐在教室后排那个沉默寡言、有时还会盯着你看太久的女孩。没有人是真心喜欢她的……

欲火焚身的小露娜带着一个亟待试用的新玩具，决定自己找点乐子。然而，她在学校里冒险自慰的举动终究难逃被人发现的命运！

也只有露娜会倒霉透顶到这种地步——不仅一边自言自语一边自慰的场面被自己最害怕的恶霸抓了个正着，随后还被剥光衣服扔在原地自生自灭！

赤身露体的她究竟该如何摆脱这羞耻暴露的困境？
